text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower hasn't turned up for training yet. I wonder what could be holding her up, when…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I spotted a bud in a flower bed that was just about to bloom…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So I stopped to give it some encouragement and lost track of time… I'm really, really sorry…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower seems remorseful about being late, so I let her off with a warning to be more careful in the future.
